selection_criteria: Lowest Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) and highest Coefficient of Determination (R²) on holdout test set.

pipeline_stages: VectorAssembler (State_Vec, Season_Vec, Numerical Features, Engineered Intensities)
StandardScaler (Scaling assembled vectors with unit standard deviation)

excluded_features.Production: Post-harvest aggregate directly tied to Yield (Yield = Production / Area); causes target leakage.
excluded_features.Crop: Constant for single-crop Cotton models; used only when running cross-crop comparison.
